description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 模型接入 Operit。侧边栏入口可查看账号状态、发起登录、读取模型清单、积分与限时活动。国内版与国际版两个区域并行使用。需先在本机部署反代服务，步骤见项目主页。本项目按 MIT 授权提供，改编自 dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy。
description.en: Connect WorkBuddy models to Operit. Sidebar entry for account status, sign-in, model catalog, credits and limited-time events. Both regions run in parallel. Requires a locally deployed bridge service; see the project home for setup. Adapted from dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy (MIT).
